_notes: Register: the German student bundle and all student-facing mobile strings use du (0 Sie / 148 du in the job's existing cur); kept du everywhere a student reads it. Staff-facing mobile:agency.*, mobile:university.*, mobile:v3.agency.*, mobile:v3.uni.*, mobile:v3.reviews.*, mobile:v3.tasks.*, mobile:v3.deadlines.*, mobile:v4.uni.*, mobile:v29.mfa.* are Sie or impersonal; mobile:agency.login.tagline («Deine Fälle») and mobile:v4.reviews.tickAll were moved to Sie. Shared screens (mobile:login.networkError, mobile:settings.*, mobile:messages.empty*, mobile:v3.upload.camera/files/failed) are written without a pronoun so they fit all three apps.

plan = «Paket» everywhere (established 22× in de/student.json; «Plan» collides with Studienplan/Kostenplan). Fixed the outliers: student:v29.services.legacyContract («Tarif») and mobile:v3.home.noCounselor («Support-Plan»). Owner decision: de/student.json keys outside this job (v29.services.addOn.noPressure, v29.services.upgrade.used) still say «Tarif».

Standard admission letter = «Standard-Zulassungsschreiben», plain admission letter = «Zulassungsschreiben» (brief's official-name list). mobile:v3.visa.beforeBody («Zulassungsbescheid») and student:v22.home.appTeam.letter aligned. Owner decision: 10 strings outside the job (student visaV2.whenText «Standard-Zulassungsbescheid», others) still use «Zulassungsbescheid»; a global rename would make it one term.

mock interview = «Probeinterview» (the term in de/common.json pricing/add-ons); student:v17.upgrade.feature.mock_interview changed from «Übungsgespräch». Outside the job, student v26.now.kind.MOCK_INTERVIEW still says «Übungsgespräch» (owner to rename).

visa document preparation = «Vorbereitung der Visumsunterlagen» (matches common v29.pricing «Vorbereitung deiner Visumsunterlagen»); replaced the vaguer «Visumsvorbereitung» in student:v15.services.scope.visa_support and v17.gate.what.visa. Visa application = «Visumantrag» (9× in bundle) rather than «Visumsantrag».

matches = «Treffer» (established); mobile:signup.quickGo said «Empfehlungen», which is reserved for university recommendations (Hochschulempfehlungen). Essays stay «Texte» as the bundle already does; personal statement = Motivationsschreiben, study plan = Studienplan, editing = Korrektur.
Application deadline = «Bewerbungsschluss {{date}}» (student:home.closes said «Endet am», which reads like an end date); task due date = «Fällig am»; agency 'promise' (SLA) = «Zusage» / «Prüfzusage».

Team identity: four student-facing cur strings named «dein Berater/deine Beraterin» where the English says the Hangyul team (V22 team identity, and the slash form is not gender-neutral); rewritten to «das Hangyul-Team». Team-name spelling left as the bundle has it («Hangyul-Team» for 'Hangyul team', «Hangyul Univ-Team» / «Team Hangyul Univ» for 'Hangyul Univ team'); not churned.

Gender-neutral staff wording without Binnen-I/asterisk/colon: applicant = «Bewerbende» (pl.) / «bewerbende Person» (sg.), student = «Studierende» / «studierende Person», counselor = «die zuständige Person (bei Hangyul)», singular SLA line «Jemand wartet auf Ihre Antwort», cohort _one forms use «Person». Verify (agency action) = «verifizieren», review = «prüfen», intake = «Aufnahmetermin» (established 6×), flag = «Markierung».

Fixed added or softened claims: student:v17.gate.named said «Hangyul übernimmt {{what}}» (not in English, over-promises) → «Ein Paket enthält {{what}}»; v17.gate.what.housing («die Unterkunft») → «Hilfe beim Wohnheim»; v17.gate.what.messages («das Hangyul Univ-Team») → «Nachrichten mit dem Hangyul-Team»; v17.upgrade.feature.document_review «Vollständige» → «Intensive»; onboarding.goals.degreeSub.LANGUAGE dropped the added «üblicher, sanfter Einstieg»; mobile:signup.consent.CROSS_BORDER_VERIFICATION.summary dropped detail the English does not list and now equals the web string; register/signup PRIVACY.summary say «Passwort (verschlüsselt gespeichert)», not «Passwort-Hash».

student:onboarding.education.institutionPh keeps «Hanoi National University» untranslated (never invent a translated institution name). {{label}} in mobile:v4.home.item.*.title is a document name inserted without article («Korrigiere {{label}} für {{university}}») so any label works.

Plurals: German has only _one/_other; every family in the job has both forms and the _one form carries {{count}} where the English does (e.g. «{{count}} erledigten Schritt anzeigen» / «{{count}} erledigte Schritte anzeigen»). mobile:v3.deadlines.bucket.*_other exist alone in the job and were translated count-neutrally.
